# Window

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

One weekly window.

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/schedule/windows`, `/policy/scope/schedule/windows`, `/policy/unknown/scope_groups/all_of/schedule/windows`, `/policy/unknown/scopes/schedule/windows`, `/rule_sets/rules/scope/schedule/windows`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `days` | array of [`Weekday`](types.md#weekday) | yes |  | 1 to 7 items | 1.0.0 | The days the window starts on. At least one, each once. |
| `duration_mins` | integer | no |  | 1 to 10080; format `uint32` | 1.0.0 | How long it lasts, in minutes, from 1 to 10080. |
| `end` | [`TimeOfDay`](types.md#timeofday) | no |  |  | 1.0.0 | When it ends, `HH:MM`. At or before `start` means the next day. Exactly one of `end` and `duration_mins`. |
| `start` | [`TimeOfDay`](types.md#timeofday) | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 | When the window starts, `HH:MM`. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
